findings.evidence: Signed receipt key appends private-loopback-signed-v1. fingerprintCacheComputation requires key.profile equal to toolchain.profile, whose schema currently names local base profiles.
findings.consequence: Authenticated lab evidence cannot currently pass the real operational fingerprint gate.

findings.evidence: Pilot receipt configurationDigest and toolchainDigest are copied from current.source; signedRootConfiguration is separately hashed after enabling remoteCache and signature. Operational contractIdentity returns projectCacheActivation when activation exists, which changes the selected cache flag and activation source hash.
findings.consequence: Binding contract.pins.configuration to the source digest cannot also treat it as the activated or signed execution digest. The concrete contract must state which identity each pin represents.

findings.evidence: runtimeIdentity replaces Turbo executable and runtime linker with the selected channel before hashing. Source toolchainDigest and runtimeKeyDigest may coincide for stable but need not coincide for canary.
findings.consequence: Channel runtime identity needs independent validation; equality on one stable report cannot erase this requirement.

implementationConstraints: Keep ordinary fingerprint profile equality and activation drift validation intact.
Model reviewed base-source identity and protected execution identity explicitly; do not strip profile suffixes or relabel source digests.
Bind the complete activation request and signed root projection into the independent approval and both authenticated reports.
Candidate and shadow admission must validate the same explicit profile contract as qualified admission.
Prove real fingerprint and projection behavior without mocking them before claiming operational native qualification.
Preserve fresh execution authority and keep ordinary checkout activation outside scoped lab evidence.
status: implementation-required; no qualification or new exception
